name: pico_i3_1l0_na
source: Game engine for the Pico city car (racing_game, docs/new_cars_plan.md Q9: 'a 1.0 l 3 cylinder N/A engine with sound'). Not a real engine: an [AS] generic 2018-2022 A-segment 1.0 L naturally aspirated DOHC 12-valve inline-three, sized after the class (Toyota 1KR-FE / VW EA211 1.0 MPI, recalled: about 50-55 kW at 6000 rpm and 90-95 N*m at about 4300 rpm). Bore 71 x stroke 84 mm x 3 = 997.6 cm3 [AS, 1KR-like]; every other number is [AS] and the generated maps are the cycle model's, nothing is fitted to a dyno sheet. Firing 1-2-3 every 240 deg (an even-firing three; no balance shaft is modelled). ECU: MBT tracking limited by the generated knock limit on E5 with a 2 deg margin (ignition_strategy knock_limited), stoichiometric part load, lambda 0.90 at full load. Measured with ps::drivetrain::run_dyno_sweep (wide-open throttle, warm, default installation, 2026-10-13): peak torque 102.8 N*m at 4300 rpm, peak power 54.1 kW at 5800 rpm.

lambda_target.source: [AS] stoichiometric part load, power enrichment at wide-open throttle (lambda 0.90)

cycle.source: [AS] 12-valve DOHC breathing: 2 x 24.5 mm intake / 2 x 21 mm exhaust valves, 232 / 228 deg duration, 7.0 / 7.3 mm lift, IVO 8 BTDC / EVC 4 BTDC (4 deg of overlap, no cam phaser modelled); 420 mm runners into a 1.5 L plenum, 280 mm primaries into one 3-into-1 collector. Assumed, not measured.

intake.source: [AS] 46 mm throttle, 1.5 L plenum, 420 mm runners 36 -> 32 mm.

exhaust.source: [AS] cast 3-into-1 manifold: 280 mm x 32 mm primaries, 250 mm x 40 mm collector to the flange.

mass_source: ASSUMED [AS]: an aluminium 1.0 L three-cylinder with its manifolds weighs 65-75 kg (city-car class, recalled, no citation fetched).
